Derrick H. Sun 
Website | derrick.han.sun@gmail.com| github.com/derrickhsun | San Diego, CA, 92130 | Phone: 858-397-3992 
Summary: M.S. in Computer Science with software engineering skills, industry internship, and 
research in machine learning. Experience automating workflows, building predictive models, and 
optimizing AI architectures. US Citizen. Available to work immediately, open to relocation. 
Education 
❖ Purdue University, M.S. in Computer Science           
                     August 2024 – May 2026 
o Specialization in AI and Machine Learning with focus on Computer Security 
o Advanced courses: Deep learning, Prompt Engineering (DSPy), and LLM integration 
❖ UC Berkeley, B.A. in Computer Science and in Applied Math                   June 2020 – May 2024 
o Double major with emphasis on machine learning, AI, and statistics 
o Courses: Deep Learning, Statistical Analysis, Data Structures & Algorithms 
Work Experience 
❖ Teaching Assistant | Purdue University, West Lafayette, IN.                  Fall 2024 & Spring 2025 
o Led discussion sessions and held office hours for undergraduate CS courses. 
❖ Data Scientist Intern | Bridger Investment Partners, New York, NY. May 2024 – August 2024 
o Automated data processing workflows with Prefect, removing manual workflows. 
o Ran statistical analysis of mortgage data with Python & SQL on AWS S3 & Redshift.  
❖ Research Assistant | UC Berkeley, Berkeley, CA.  
 
 December 2023 – May 2024 
o Conducted comparative analysis of transformer architectures (GPT-2, Mamba, 
LLaMA) on in-context learning tasks.  
o Results available on GitHub (code and arXiv). 
❖ iOS Developer Intern | NewsBreak, Seattle, WA.                                         May 2022 – August 2022 
o Implemented the Discover page of the NewsBreak iOS app using Swift and UIKit.  
o Developed data-fetching to retrieve & display news for user-selected organizations.  
Research and Publications 
❖ Research Coauthor | UC Berkeley, ICL with Custom Models 
 December 2023 – May 2024 
❖ Research Coauthor | UCSD, Skewed Random Utility Models  
              May 2023 – May 2024 
o Implemented empirical data analysis and Monte Carlo simulations. 
o Employed Gosper's hack and memoization to improve computational speed by 80%. 
Projects 
❖ Webnovel Downloader and Translator   
 
 
 
 
   2025 – 2026 
o Personal project that downloads online content and calls OpenAI API to translate it. 
o Utilizes Selenium to display a menu and automatically navigate the internet. 
❖ Deep Learning for Mushroom Classification (Report)  
 
 
    Spring 2025 
o Built decision trees, neural networks, and naïve Bayes classifiers to determine the 
edibility of mushrooms with >90% accuracy.  
o Deployed LIME for interpretability of the models. 
❖ Uncertainty Quantification with Neural Networks (Report) 
 
                  Spring 2025 
o Trained neural networks to approximate uncertainty in Walmart Sales, evaluating 
their performance with quantile calibration error curves.  
o Developed a NN model capable of predicting uncertainty with 10% margin of error. 
❖ Transformer Optimization (Report) 
 
 
 
 
 
          Fall 2023 
o Tested transformer performance on various simple tasks with ReLU-attention and 
quantization optimizations, reducing model runtime on simple tasks by 0.1 seconds. 
Programming Skills  
❖ Programming Languages: Python, Java, SQL, C, C++, R, MATLAB, Swift, JavaScript, HTML/CSS 
❖ ML/AI Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, DSPy, Scikit-learn 
❖ Data Tools: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, RStudio, Jupyter 
❖ Cloud & Databases: AWS S3, Redshift, PostgreSQL, MongoDB 
❖ Development Tools: Git, Docker, Prefect, XCode, LaTeX, RISC-V, Bootstrap
name: Derrick Sun
example_cover_letter:
My name is Derrick Sun, and I am writing to apply for a position at HeyGen. I recently completed a Master’s degree in Computer Science and am highly motivated by the opportunity to help build impactful AI-driven products that make visual storytelling more accessible and scalable.
My background combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience implementing AI/ML models and supporting backend systems. I have worked extensively with Python and Java to develop and integrate machine learning models, manage data workflows, and build reliable application logic. I am comfortable collaborating across the stack - working with frontend engineers, backend APIs, and ML components - to help move features from concept to production.
I am particularly excited by HeyGen’s mission and its focus on AI-powered video creation. I enjoy building systems where ML models directly shape user-facing product experiences, and I am eager to continue learning how to deploy, optimize, and maintain such systems at scale. I have experience working with RESTful APIs, relational databases, and cloud environments, and I value writing clean, maintainable code that supports rapid iteration and long-term reliability.
I would be excited to contribute to HeyGen’s product engineering efforts and to grow as a software engineer building cutting-edge AI products. Thank you for your time and consideration.
